notes: OpenAI 官方公开的是按 token 分通道计费: 文本输入 5 USD/1M、缓存文本输入 1.25 USD/1M、图片输入 8 USD/1M、缓存图片输入 2 USD/1M、图片输出 30 USD/1M。
OpenAI 文档说明 gpt-image-2 支持图像生成与图像编辑，并且图像输入始终按高保真处理。
当前 AOAI Proxy 治理计费只支持标准 token 单价，不支持 image channel 的独立自动结算，因此 pricingCatalogEntry 保持为空，避免将图片生成请求误算为普通文本 token 成本。

contextWindow, maxInputTokens, maxOutputTokens remain independently unverified for this exact deployment/endpoint. No token ceiling is inferred from a sibling model, billing unit, or subtraction of other limits.
modelVersion has not been independently verified as an exact deployment snapshot; the stable model ID is retained rather than inventing a release date or copying a sibling version.

pricing.sourceType identifies published OpenAI reference prices, not independently verified Azure deployment charges. Match the actual service tier and region or retain an explicit administrator pricing override.
